subject: general
question: How many moons does planet Mars have as of October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Two**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **two moons **of **Mars **are **Phobos **and **Deimos**.
 
• They are **irregular **in **shape**.
 
• **Both **were **discovered **by **American astronomer Asaph Hall **in **August 1877**.
 
• They are **named **after the **Greek mythological twin characters Phobos **(fear and panic) and **Deimos **(terror and dread) who accompanied **their father Ares into battle**.
 
 
• **Ares**, **god of war, **was known to the **Romans as Mars**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mars**:

 
 
• **Mars **is the **fourth planet **from the **Sun **and the **second-smallest planet **in the **Solar System**, being larger **than only Mercury**.
 
• In the **English language**, Mars is named for **the Roman god of war**.
 
• **Temperatures **on **Mars **average about **-81 degrees F**.
 
• **Mars **is also known as **the Red Planet**. 
 
• **Mars **is **named **after the **Roman god of war**.
 
• **Mars **has **2 moons called Deimos and Phobos**.
 
• **Mars **is the **4th planet from the sun**. 
 
• **Mars **is **smaller than Earth **with a **diameter of 4217 miles.**
